---
title: "typst-equations example"
format:
  html: default
  typst: default
filters:
  - typst-equations
---

Formulas below are written once, in native Typst math syntax — no LaTeX
anywhere. On Typst/PDF output they render natively (no compile step
needed, it's already valid Typst). On HTML output each formula is
compiled to a small SVG via `quarto typst compile` and cached.

Inline math: $mu$ and $sigma^2$, so $X tilde.op cal(N)(mu, sigma^2)$
describes a Normal random variable, right in the middle of a sentence.

A superscripted distribution label (note the `upright()` wrapper — plain
`f^"Bin"(...)` without it would space out as separate italic letters):

$$ f^upright("Bin")(k; n, p) = binom(n, k) p^k (1-p)^(n-k) $$

An `iid` sequence:

$$ K_1, dots, K_m tilde.op^upright("iid") "Bernoulli"(p) $$
